parameters.name: AddressLike
parameters.description: The address to query. You can set this parameter to perform a fuzzy match on added addresses.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token for the next page. Set this parameter to the value of **NextToken** returned in the previous API call. Leave this parameter empty for the first page.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the address book to query.
